name: Turin DF54
details: Electric single-dose grinder with 54 mm flat burrs and a stepless dial numbered 0–90. Also sold under other brands.

rangeInfo.note: Honest Coffee Guide's chart (community, not the manufacturer's): Turkish 0–12, espresso 8–30, moka pot 29–62, AeroPress 24–90, V60 34–67, filter coffee machine 22–89, French press 67–90, cold brew 79–90. Its V60 row is used for pour-over, “Filter Coffee Machine” for drip, French press for immersion.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
